scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build:client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join(__dirname, 'client', 'dist'); const dest = path.join(__dirname, 'server', 'public'); if (!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true});"
